name: search_books
description: Search for books by title or author name. Returns book IDs, titles, authors, and download counts.

query.description: Title or author name to search for.

name: get_book
description: Get full details for a book by ID. Returns title, author, publication year, language, available formats, and download count.

id.description: The numeric Project Gutenberg book ID.

name: popular_books
description: Get the most downloaded books ranked by popularity. Returns titles, authors, IDs, and download statistics.

name: books_by_topic
description: Browse books by subject or topic (e.g., 'science fiction', 'philosophy'). Returns matching titles, authors, and IDs.

topic.description: Topic or subject keyword to filter books by (e.g. "science", "love", "history").
